column3: “His course” follows the reading tradition; the written text has the plural “courses.”
“Crane” is rendered “thrush”; the bird names are uncertain.
The Hebrew “gather, I will make an end of them” is difficult; NASB has “surely snatch them away.” The meaning is uncertain.
“He has silenced us” is rendered “has doomed us.”
The Hebrew “my cheerfulness over sorrow” is obscure; NASB has “My sorrow is beyond healing.” The meaning is uncertain.
